notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least six lands.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Carpet of Flowers triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Carpet of Flowers's ability.
Resolve the copy of Carpet of Flowers's ability, targeting an opponent that controls at least six lands, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
